desc: Implement the moving anti-diagonal frontier solution with padded arrays, optional transpose, precomputed diagonals, full initial DP, and correct query update order.
Handle zero weights and start/end cells via border-one trick (no division), and verify boundary cases.
Test on provided samples plus edge cases: zero values, updating start/end, thin grids, oscillating walks, and maximum square-ish grid.
Optimize hot loops if needed (local variable bindings, precomputed diagonal lists, minimal modulo operations) and profile worst-case performance.
If the frontier approach is too slow in Python, evaluate an alternative block/transfer-matrix method, but only after measuring the frontier implementation.
